purpose: Prove end-to-end role-aware onboarding, Help, tutorial, optional GM Academy and support workflows across all 18 teaching surfaces, all nine governed roles and P13-MUT-001 persistence/recovery while preserving upstream authority, hidden-state safety, source grounding, accessibility and no-runtime boundaries.

handoffs.name: identity_role_workspace_entry
handoffs.rule: Teaching consumes authorized identity, role and workspace projection; it cannot alter authentication, role, delegation, membership or entitlement.

handoffs.name: character_creation
handoffs.rule: Teaching explains authorized Character creation state and source links without creating mechanics or silently defaulting unsupported source truth.

handoffs.name: campaign_scene_session_authoring
handoffs.rule: Teaching distinguishes authored draft, saved authoring state and live authoritative Campaign/Scene/Session state; it cannot promote tutorial or Academy drafts.

handoffs.name: first_action_and_approval
handoffs.rule: Teaching preserves preview, proposal, pending, GM decision and accepted result distinctions and never commits gameplay state.

handoffs.name: permissions_hidden_information
handoffs.rule: Authorization and minimum-field filtering occur before discovery, search, counts, examples, tutorials, diagnostics, exports and AI context.

handoffs.name: offline_reconnect_recovery
handoffs.rule: Teaching distinguishes local draft/cache, submitted command, accepted durable Event, displayed projection and status-unknown outcomes; offline does not imply authoritative mutation.

handoffs.name: onboarding_help_support
handoffs.rule: PPIA-13 provides teaching identity, delivery and support handoff over F025 behavior without widening support access or diagnostics.

handoffs.name: teaching_progress_persistence
handoffs.rule: Only teaching progress/preferences/bookmarks persist here; authorization, expected_version, operation_id, stale rejection, idempotent status lookup and durable receipts govern writes.

handoffs.name: gm_academy_instructional_sources
handoffs.rule: GM craft is optional advisory instruction; Academy completion never gates role, permission, entitlement, feature or gameplay capability.

handoffs.name: multiversal_canonical_grounding
handoffs.rule: Multiversal-specific factual teaching renders only from cited canonical grounding; outline-only unsupported headings remain explicit gaps.

handoffs.name: tutorial_and_world_creation_fixtures
handoffs.rule: Tutorial-Campaign and World Creation outputs are synthetic/noncanonical drafts and never auto-promote to Campaign, setting or source truth.

handoffs.name: p14_microcopy
handoffs.rule: PPIA-13 may explain state meaning and safe next-step categories; PPIA-14 owns final state-by-state error, recovery and permission wording.

handoffs.name: diagnostics_export_notifications_ai
handoffs.owner: F025 support/diagnostic boundary and owning service contracts
handoffs.rule: Only allowlisted/redacted data crosses support/service/AI handoffs; AI remains optional, read-only and zero-AI equivalent.

projection_group_resolution: Projection-group coverage is derived deterministically from each workflow action using PPIA-13_TEACHING_LIBRARY_ACTION_CONTRACT_MATRIX_v0.1.0.json; workflow rows do not duplicate projection-group lists.

workflows.name: first_launch_role_workspace_help_rediscovery
workflows.result: First-use teaching resolves role/workspace safely, persists only teaching state and keeps Help rediscoverable.

workflows.name: campaign_join_and_player_resume
workflows.result: Campaign join/resume teaching preserves membership authority and re-authorizes bookmarks before use.

workflows.name: character_creation_library_inspector_source_grounding
workflows.result: Character creation and Inspector teaching preserve source provenance without inventing mechanics.

workflows.name: gm_campaign_scene_session_authoring_contextual_academy
workflows.result: GM authoring receives optional Academy craft at the correct surface without transferring Campaign authority.

workflows.name: first_action_player_teaching
workflows.result: First-Action teaching preserves proposal-to-result state distinctions and cannot mutate gameplay.

workflows.name: gm_approval_loop_teaching
workflows.result: Approval-loop teaching is role-aware and preserves accepted durable result evidence.

workflows.name: permissions_hidden_information_nonleak
workflows.result: Hidden information remains non-inferable through every teaching derivative and empty state.

workflows.name: offline_reconnect_status_unknown_and_idempotent_recovery
workflows.result: Offline/reconnect and ambiguous teaching writes recover by operation identity before retry.

workflows.name: tutorial_campaign_player_gm_flow
workflows.result: Tutorial Campaign teaches the full governed loop while remaining synthetic, replayable and noncanonical.

workflows.name: gm_academy_foundations_intermediate_progression
workflows.result: Foundations/Intermediate Academy progress is optional, source-backed and canonically bounded.

workflows.name: gm_academy_advanced_worldbuilding_creator_guidance
workflows.result: Advanced/Worldbuilding Academy guidance produces drafts only and preserves canonical Species/setting authority.

workflows.name: multiversal_academy_grounded_vs_gap
workflows.result: Multiversal Academy factual lessons require canonical grounding; unsupported headings remain explicit gaps.

workflows.name: pack_context_source_gap_teaching
workflows.result: Pack teaching remains limited to evidenced context and preserves the unresolved F024 source gap.

workflows.name: glossary_reference_provenance_and_known_limitations
workflows.result: Glossary/reference and known limitations stay source-grounded, permission-safe and return-context preserving.

workflows.name: diagnostics_issue_reporting_and_support_handoff
workflows.result: Diagnostics/support handoff is redacted and concept-level while PPIA-14 retains final microcopy.

workflows.name: dismiss_replay_preferences_bookmarks_and_reset
workflows.result: Dismiss/replay/bookmark/reset writes affect only optional teaching state and are versioned/idempotent.

workflows.name: accessibility_mobile_nonvisual_and_zero_ai_parity
workflows.result: Every required teaching path has equivalent mobile, keyboard, touch, screen-reader, high-zoom, reduced-motion, noncolor and zero-AI semantics.

workflows.name: service_ai_admin_projection_and_revocation_safety
workflows.result: Service/AI/admin/delegated projections remain minimum-authorized and contract immediately on revocation.
